newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Chunghwa, Singapore Telecom in deal-paper.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Chunghwa, Singapore Telecom in deal-paper.

text.p: Taiwan's state-run Chunghwa Telecommunication Corp has reached agreement with Singapore Telecom to launch a satellite communications joint venture, a Taiwan newspaper reported on Monday.
The Commercial Times said Chunghwa and Singapore Telecom discussed the venture at a meeting in January, and a final deal would be struck "in the short term".
It did not give further details. Chunghwa declined to comment on the report.
Singapore Telecom in January failed to win one of eight Taiwan mobile phone franchises awarded by Taiwan's government under the privatisation of the island's telecommunications industry.
Chunghwa is a state-run enterprise that was spun off from the old monopoly Directorate General of Telecommunications.
